name: io.github.shekibahmed/oiw-mcp
title: Operations Intelligence Workbench
description: Scenario Packs, adversarial synthetic fixtures, an evidence casebook and pack checks.

environmentVariables.name: OIW_REPO_ROOT
environmentVariables.description: Path to an Operations Intelligence Workbench checkout. Read tools also work from the packs shipped in the npm package. Command tools need a checkout.

environmentVariables.name: SCENARIO_PACKS_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Directory of Scenario Packs to read. Defaults to scenario-packs in the checkout, or the copy shipped in the package.

environmentVariables.name: OIW_MCP_ALLOW_WRITE
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to register scaffold_pack and allow it to create pack directories. Unset by default.

environmentVariables.name: OIW_MCP_ALLOW_EVAL
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to register run_eval on the HTTP transport. It writes to DATABASE_URL. stdio registers it already.

environmentVariables.name: OIW_MCP_ALLOWED_TOOLS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated allow list. Intersected with the tools this process may register. Does not enable a tool by itself.

environmentVariables.name: OIW_MCP_AUTH_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: When set, HTTP /mcp requires Authorization: Bearer with this value. /health stays open.

environmentVariables.name: OIW_MCP_TRANSPORT
environmentVariables.description: Set to http to listen with streamable HTTP instead of stdio. --stdio still forces stdio.

environmentVariables.name: OIW_MCP_HOST
environmentVariables.description: HTTP bind address. Default 127.0.0.1. A non-loopback host refuses write and eval tools unless OIW_MCP_AUTH_TOKEN is set.

environmentVariables.name: OIW_MCP_PORT
environmentVariables.description: HTTP port. Default 8787. The MCP path is /mcp.
